name: Parametric Azteeg X3 Mount for Arduino Mega/RAMPS holes

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a mounting adapter plate featuring an open, rectangular frame with curved, organic-looking support struts. It has four tall, hollow cylindrical standoffs located at the outer corners for mounting a Panucatt X3 controller. Inside the frame, there are four shorter, smaller-diameter hollow cylindrical standoffs positioned to align with the mounting holes of an Arduino Mega or RAMPS board.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric mounting adapter that bridges an Arduino Mega/RAMPS mounting hole pattern with a Panucatt X3 controller pattern. The script should allow users to adjust the standoff heights, wall thicknesses, and inner hole radii for both sets of mounting points, connecting them with a flat, curved barbell-style support frame.
captions.factory: The design is built by combining two main standoff modules. The 'standoff' module uses a difference of two cylinders to create a hollow post. The 'arduino_mega_standoffs' and 'x3_standoffs' modules position these posts using defined coordinate arrays. The posts are connected together at the base using a custom 'barbell' 2D module (constructed from circles and a polygon) that is extruded using linear_extrude to form a rigid, curved bridging frame.
